integrity: The universal-cover construction for the 13-point projective-plane model is explicitly attributed to prior work. The new claim is the fiberwise beat-point equivalence, the induced core-scaling theorem, and its finite-homotopy consequence. The concrete application is replayed by a dependency-free verifier.
scientific_limitations: The core-scaling theorem is stated for finite regular coverings represented by admissible connected finite-group colorings. The projective-plane application does not claim that 26 is extremal among all beat-point-free finite models of weak type S^2.
title: Core size multiplies under finite regular poset coverings
